tool.name: miRge3.0
tool.command:
#import os #set $sample_list = [] #for $i, $s in enumerate($samples): #set $fname = 'sample_' + str($i) + '.fastq' ln -s '$s' $fname && $sample_list.append($fname) #end for
mkdir -p output_dir &&
miRge3.0 -s '#echo ",".join($sample_list)#' -lib '${libraries_path.fields.path}' -on '${organism_name}' -db '${mir_db}' -o output_dir -cpu \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -ex ${cr_threshold} #if str($adapter): -a '${adapter}' #end if #if str($front_adapter): -g '${front_adapter}' #end if -m ${minimum_length} #if str($quality_cutoff): -q '${quality_cutoff}' #end if #if $trim_n: -NX #end if #if $phred64: -phr #end if ## UMI section #if str($sec_umi.umi): -umi '${sec_umi.umi}' #end if #if $sec_umi.umi_dedup: -udd #end if #if $sec_umi.qiagen_umi: -qumi #end if ## Analysis toggles #if $sec_analysis.atoI: -ai #end if #if $sec_analysis.trf: -trf #end if #if $sec_analysis.novel_mirna: -nmir -minl ${sec_analysis.min_length} -maxl ${sec_analysis.max_length} -c ${sec_analysis.min_read_counts} -mloc ${sec_analysis.max_mapping_loci} -sl ${sec_analysis.seed_length} -olc ${sec_analysis.overlap_len_cutoff} -clc ${sec_analysis.cluster_length} #end if #if $sec_analysis.isoform_entropy: -ie #end if #if $sec_analysis.spike_in: -spk #end if #if $sec_analysis.gff_out: -gff #end if #if $sec_analysis.bam_out: -bam #end if #if $sec_analysis.tcf_out: -tcf #end if ## Error correction #if $sec_mirec.mirec: -mEC -kh ${sec_mirec.threshold} -ks ${sec_mirec.kmer_start} -ke ${sec_mirec.kmer_end} #end if ## Differential expression #if $sec_diffex.diffex: -dex -mdt '${sec_diffex.metadata}' #end if -shh &&
## The output is in a timestamped subdirectory; find it #set $result_dir = $os.listdir('output_dir')[0] #set $rd = 'output_dir/' + $result_dir
## Move key outputs to expected Galaxy paths cp '$rd/annotation.report.html' '$annotation_report_html' && cp '$rd/annotation.report.csv' '$annotation_report_csv' && cp '$rd/miR.Counts.csv' '$mir_counts' && cp '$rd/miR.RPM.csv' '$mir_rpm' && cp '$rd/mapped.csv' '$mapped_csv' && cp '$rd/run.log' '$log_file' && cp '$rd/miRge3_visualization.html' '$visualization_html' && mkdir -p '${visualization_html.files_path}' && cp '$rd/index_data.js' '${visualization_html.files_path}/index_data.js' && #if $sec_analysis.gff_out: cp '$rd/'*_miRge3.gff '$isomir_gff' && #end if #if $sec_analysis.novel_mirna: cp '$rd/FOLDER_novel_miRNAs/'*_novel_miRNAs_report.csv '$novel_mirna_report' && #end if #if $sec_analysis.atoI: cp '$rd/a2IEditing.report.csv' '$atoi_report' && #end if #if $sec_analysis.trf: cp '$rd/tRFs.potential.report.tsv' '$trf_report' && cp '$rd/tRF.Counts.csv' '$trf_counts' && #end if true

param.name: samples
param.label: Input FASTQ file(s)
param.help: One or more FASTQ files (optionally gzipped). Multiple samples can be provided for cross-sample analysis and differential expression.

param.name: libraries_path
param.label: miRge3.0 organism libraries
param.help: Pre-configured organism annotation libraries. If your organism is not available, contact the administrator.

validator.message: No miRge3.0 libraries are configured on this instance. Please contact the administrator.

param.name: organism_name
param.label: Organism
param.help: Select the organism corresponding to your samples and libraries.

param.name: mir_db
param.label: miRNA database
param.help: Choose the miRNA annotation database to use.

param.name: adapter
param.label: 3' adapter sequence
param.help: 3' adapter sequence to trim, or 'illumina' for the default Illumina adapter.

param.name: front_adapter
param.label: 5' adapter sequence
param.help: 5' adapter sequence, or a linked adapter string (e.g. 5'...3').

param.name: minimum_length
param.label: Minimum read length
param.help: (-m) Discard reads shorter than this length after trimming.

param.name: quality_cutoff
param.label: Quality trimming cutoff
param.help: (-q) Quality trimming, e.g. '20' or '20,20' for 5',3' cutoffs.

param.name: trim_n
param.label: Trim N's from read ends
param.help: (-NX) Remove N bases from the beginning and end of reads.

param.name: phred64
param.label: Use phred64 quality encoding
param.help: (-phr) Set if your FASTQ files use phred64 quality scores (default is phred33).

param.name: cr_threshold
param.label: Canonical read proportion threshold
param.help: (-ex) Threshold for canonical read proportion (0-0.5).

param.name: umi
param.label: UMI lengths
param.help: (-umi) Trim UMI of specified lengths at 5',3' (e.g. '4,4').

param.name: umi_dedup
param.label: Remove PCR duplicates
param.help: (-udd) Remove PCR duplicates using UMI. Requires UMI lengths to be specified.

param.name: qiagen_umi
param.label: Qiagen UMI processing
param.help: (-qumi) Use Qiagen-specific UMI processing.

param.name: atoI
param.label: A-to-I RNA editing analysis
param.help: (-ai) Detect A-to-I RNA editing sites.

param.name: trf
param.label: tRNA fragment (tRF) analysis
param.help: (-trf) Analyze tRNA fragments.

param.name: novel_mirna
param.label: Novel miRNA prediction
param.help: (-nmir) Predict novel miRNAs (trained on human/mouse).

param.name: isoform_entropy
param.label: IsomiR entropy calculation
param.help: (-ie) Calculate isomiR entropy.

param.name: spike_in
param.label: Spike-in annotation
param.help: (-spk) Annotate spike-in sequences.

param.name: gff_out
param.label: Output isomiRs in GFF format
param.help: (-gff) Generate GFF output of isomiRs.

param.name: bam_out
param.label: Output BAM files
param.help: (-bam) Produce BAM alignment files.

param.name: tcf_out
param.label: Write trimmed/collapsed FASTA
param.help: (-tcf) Write trimmed and collapsed reads as FASTA.

param.name: min_length
param.label: Novel miRNA minimum length
param.help: (-minl) Minimum length for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: max_length
param.label: Novel miRNA maximum length
param.help: (-maxl) Maximum length for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: min_read_counts
param.label: Novel miRNA minimum read counts
param.help: (-c) Minimum read counts for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: max_mapping_loci
param.label: Novel miRNA max mapping loci
param.help: (-mloc) Maximum mapping loci for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: seed_length
param.label: Novel miRNA seed length
param.help: (-sl) Seed length for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: overlap_len_cutoff
param.label: Novel miRNA overlap length cutoff
param.help: (-olc) Overlap length cutoff for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: cluster_length
param.label: Novel miRNA cluster length
param.help: (-clc) Cluster length for novel miRNA prediction.

param.name: mirec
param.label: Enable error correction
param.help: (-mEC) Enable miRNA error correction.

param.name: threshold
param.label: Frequency threshold
param.help: (-kh) Frequency threshold tau for error correction.

param.name: kmer_start
param.label: Kmer start
param.help: (-ks) Kmer start position for error correction.

param.name: kmer_end
param.label: Kmer end
param.help: (-ke) Kmer end position for error correction.

param.name: diffex
param.label: Differential expression via DESeq2
param.help: (-dex) Perform differential expression analysis using DESeq2. Requires a metadata CSV file.

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata CSV file
param.help: (-mdt) CSV metadata file for DESeq2. Required if differential expression is enabled.

tool.help:
# What it does
miRge3.0 is a comprehensive small RNA-seq analysis pipeline. It performs:
- Adapter trimming and quality filtering (via Cutadapt) - Read collapsing and UMI processing/deduplication - Alignment to small-RNA annotation libraries (via Bowtie) - Known miRNA quantification (raw counts and RPM) - IsomiR analysis with optional GFF output and entropy calculation - A-to-I RNA editing detection - tRNA fragment (tRF) analysis - Novel miRNA prediction (trained on human/mouse) - Differential expression analysis (via DESeq2) - Interactive HTML visualization reports
## Libraries
miRge3.0 requires organism-specific annotation libraries. These are pre-configured on this Galaxy instance. If your organism is not available, please contact the administrator. Libraries can be built using `miRge3_build <https://github.com/mhalushka/miRge3_build>`_.
## Input
One or more FASTQ files (optionally gzipped). Multiple samples can be provided for cross-sample analysis and differential expression.
## Output
The tool produces annotation reports (HTML + CSV), miRNA count matrices (raw + RPM), optional isomiR GFF, novel miRNA predictions, A-to-I editing reports, tRF reports, and an interactive visualization HTML.
For full documentation, see the `miRge3.0 docs <https://mirge3.readthedocs.io/>`_.
